description: Build a rebate/incentive agreement by talking it through — no document needed. Describe the program in plain words and Aurgus DRAFTS the terms (who qualifies, how volume is measured and over what period, the threshold, the rate or per-unit reward, any cap, and approval routing) and asks the consultant-style questions a controller would ask before assuming. IMPORTANT: these terms are DRAFTED by the model from your words — they are PROPOSED, NOT PARSED, and nothing is created. When the terms are right, call again with finalize=true and the reviewed proposal, and Aurgus stages it for a person with approval authority to approve in the browser (you can NOT approve your own). This is how you establish an agreement (ASC 606 step 1) when you have no document — before any transaction data is asked for. When a document exists, prefer ingest_agreement (its deterministic parser touches the numbers with zero LLM).

clarifications.description: Answers to the follow-up questions from a previous turn, so the draft refines. Each item pairs the question asked with the answer.

description.description: Plain-language description of the program — who it's for, how it's measured and over what period, the rate/threshold/cap, the dates. On the first turn, just describe it.

finalize.description: Set true ONLY after the terms have been reviewed and the follow-ups resolved. Stages the proposal for human approval; omit/false to just draft and refine.

proposal.description: Required when finalize=true: the EXACT drafted proposal returned by a prior (non-finalize) call, echoed back verbatim — so what is staged is exactly what was reviewed. Staging does NOT re-run the model.

name: compose_agreement
